summary.en: A dedicated dressing corner with the mirror and storage brought together.
summary.zh: 把镜面与收纳整合到一个梳妆角落。

description.en:
A white dressing-table design with a tall mirror, side shelves and drawer storage. The compact arrangement brings everyday cosmetics and accessories around one seated area.
Confirm the overall dimensions, mirror arrangement and whether a stool is included when you enquire.
description.zh:
白色梳妆台将高镜、侧边置物格和抽屉收纳放在一起，便于围绕坐式梳妆区域整理日常用品。
询价时请确认整体尺寸、镜面配置，以及是否需要配套坐凳。

en: Mirror and storage arranged around the dressing area.
White appearance for a light interior scheme.
Confirm stool, hardware and packing requirements with the model.
zh: 围绕梳妆区域配置镜面与收纳。
白色外观适合浅色空间搭配。
坐凳、五金及包装要求按款式确认。

value.en: White finish; mirror, open shelves and drawers
value.zh: 白色外观，镜面、开放格及抽屉组合

value.en: Request model-specific order and sample terms
value.zh: 按款式询价确认起订量及样品条件

value.en: Confirm packing, assembly requirements and current lead time
value.zh: 核对包装、组装要求及当前交期
